Grit sapnon ko haqeeqat banati hai.
Khamoshi mein hi taqat ki jad hai.
Jab sach bol sakte ho, chup mat raho.
Saahas hamesha doosre saahas ko pukaarta hai.
Himmat sword nikali hui mohabbat hai.
Grit persistence ki habit hai.
Lagatar koshish grit ki aatma hai.
Chuppi mann ka mandir hai.
Courage aur grit repetition mein forged hote.
Har experience se strength, courage, confidence banta hai—jab tum fear ko face karte ho.
Grit seemayein todti hai.
Himmat andar ka decision hai.
Real test of courage yeh hai ki kya tum defeat endure kar sakte ho.
Shak dushman nahi; darr dushman hai.
Khamoshi impulse par jeet hai.
Mind empty, formless, shapeless—jaise paani.
Nadi chattan ko shakti se nahi, balki apni nirantar mehnat se kaat ti hai.
Grit momentum create karta.
Khamoshi power hai.
Grit buniyad hai.
